        and "finance_closing_snapshots"."customer_deposit_adjustment_out" >= 0
        and "finance_closing_snapshots"."customer_deposit_closing_balance" >= 0

inventory_movements_reference_guard_uq.name: inventory_movements_reference_guard_uq
inventory_movements_reference_guard_uq.where: "inventory_movements"."reference_type" is not null and "inventory_movements"."reference_id" is not null

        and "legacy_migration_sold_records"."product_item_id" is null
        and "legacy_migration_sold_records"."previous_verification_status" is null
        and "legacy_migration_sold_records"."previous_item_availability" is null
      ) or (
        "legacy_migration_sold_records"."verification_id" is not null
        and "legacy_migration_sold_records"."previous_verification_status" in (
          'submitted',
          'needs_review',
          'returned',
          'approved',
          'rejected'
        )
        and (
          ("legacy_migration_sold_records"."product_item_id" is null and "legacy_migration_sold_records"."previous_item_availability" is null)
          or (
            "legacy_migration_sold_records"."product_item_id" is not null
            and "legacy_migration_sold_records"."previous_item_availability" = 'migration_hold'
            and "legacy_migration_sold_records"."previous_verification_status" = 'approved'
          )
        )
      )

        and "legacy_migration_sold_records"."reverted_at" is null

      ) or (

        and "legacy_migration_sold_records"."reverted_at" is not null
        and length(btrim("legacy_migration_sold_records"."revert_reason")) >= 5

legacy_migration_verifications_source_ck.name: legacy_migration_verifications_source_ck

        and "legacy_migration_verifications"."legacy_row_id" is null
      )

legacy_migration_verifications_photo_ck.name: legacy_migration_verifications_photo_ck
legacy_migration_verifications_photo_ck.value:
(

        and "legacy_migration_verifications"."legacy_image_url" is not null
        and "legacy_migration_verifications"."image_key" is null

      )

        and "legacy_product_master_mappings"."target_product_master_id" is null
        and "legacy_product_master_mappings"."mapping_source" is null
        and "legacy_product_master_mappings"."reviewed_by" is null

        and "legacy_product_master_mappings"."target_product_master_id" is not null
        and "legacy_product_master_mappings"."mapping_source" is not null
        and "legacy_product_master_mappings"."reviewed_by" is not null
        and "legacy_product_master_mappings"."reviewed_at" is not null
      ) or (
        "legacy_product_master_mappings"."status" = 'ignored'
        and "legacy_product_master_mappings"."target_category_id" is null
        and "legacy_product_master_mappings"."target_product_master_id" is null
        and "legacy_product_master_mappings"."mapping_source" is null
        and "legacy_product_master_mappings"."reviewed_by" is not null

          and "manual_payment_profiles"."merchant_id" is not null

        ("manual_payment_profiles"."profile_type" = 'edc'
          and "manual_payment_profiles"."verification_source" = 'edc_terminal'
          and "manual_payment_profiles"."terminal_id" is not null

          and "manual_payment_profiles"."verification_source" in ('bank_app', 'bank_statement')

payment_reconciliations_net_formula_ck.value: "payment_reconciliations"."settlement_gross_amount" is null or "payment_reconciliations"."net_settlement_amount" is null or "payment_reconciliations"."net_settlement_amount" = "payment_reconciliations"."settlement_gross_amount" - "payment_reconciliations"."fee_amount" - "payment_reconciliations"."tax_amount"

        and "payment_reconciliations"."net_settlement_amount" is not null
        and "payment_reconciliations"."settlement_date" is not null
        and "payment_reconciliations"."settlement_reference" is not null
        and btrim("payment_reconciliations"."settlement_reference") <> ''

        and "payment_reconciliations"."resolved_by" is not null
        and "payment_reconciliations"."resolved_at" is not null
